extensionDesc.message: Summarize web pages or selected text using your favorite LLM (Web Mode or API).

lengthWarning.message: Warning: text exceeds the recommended Web Mode limit for this LLM. Use Split & Copy or switch to API Mode.

promptShortInstruction.message: Provide a concise, clear summary of the following text, focusing only on the key points in a brief bulleted list.

promptDetailedInstruction.message: Generate a complete, detailed, and well-structured summary of the following text. Organize the main concepts with clear headings and make sure not to omit important arguments, explanations, or details.

promptKeyPointsInstruction.message: Extract the key takeaways, core facts, and actionable conclusions from the following text as a clear, ordered bullet list.

localApiOnlyHint.message: Local models only support API Mode.

promptNameRequired.message: Enter a name to save the prompt.

errRestrictedPage.message: Cannot extract text from this internal browser page.

errEmptySelection.message: No text is selected on the current page.

errEmptyPage.message: No readable text found on this page.

errCaptureFailed.message: Failed to capture text from the page.

splitIntroPrefix.message:
This text is very long, so I will send it in {total} parts. Do not summarize until I send the final part marked "END OF TEXT". Reply only "OK, waiting" to intermediate parts.

Instructions to apply once you receive all parts:

queueEmpty.message: Queue is empty. Capture text before sending.

fallbackPasteMsg.message: Automatic paste failed. Click below to copy the prompt, then press Ctrl+V (or Cmd+V).

fallbackCopiedAutoMsg.message: Automatic paste failed. Prompt copied to clipboard — press Ctrl+V (or Cmd+V).

optionsApiDesc.message: Configure your API keys and model IDs for direct API Mode. You can type any valid model ID supported by each provider.

optionsSelectorsDesc.message: If an LLM site updates its interface, you can customize the comma-separated composer CSS selectors here. Leave blank to restore defaults.

optionsExtractionDesc.message: Customize how text is extracted from web pages and how the queue behaves.
